maintenance_led.reason: Regulated electric and natural gas utility selling energy delivery to households and businesses; not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from household, commercial and industrial utility customers billed for electricity and gas, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through rate-based capital investment in its regulated electric and gas utilities, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated electricity and natural gas utility serving franchise territories; customers cannot easily switch and depend on essential service.
